frequently asked questions.

short answers about how 1thing works. if you can't find what you need, write to us.

what is 1thing?

an iPhone app. every day you choose one goal, just one. when you complete it, you press and hold the circle and a piece of the painting fills with colour.

why only one goal?

long lists make everything feel urgent, and in the end nothing gets started. one small goal, for today, is close enough to actually do.

what happens if I skip a day?

nothing. the painting waits for you: it takes 30 completed goals, not necessarily in a row.

and if I haven't completed it by midnight?

today's goal disappears and tomorrow you choose a new one. the painting doesn't lose a single piece.

how many paintings are there?

five: the winter coast, the garden, the autumn wood, the red desert and the luminous. when you finish one, I hang it in your studio and a new one begins.

what is the studio?

the room you share with your companion. on the wall there's a mark for every goal you complete, and the paintings you've finished hang there. you can furnish it however you like.

why do the painting's colours change?

the painting takes on the light of the hour you complete your goal: dawn, day, sunset or night.

where can I see the days I've done?

in the calendar: the 30 pieces of the painting, each with its goal and the note you left. below it is the list of every goal you've completed.

how do I add the widget?

press and hold an empty spot on your home screen, tap + at the top, search for 1thing and choose the widget. it shows today's goal inside the painting.

how does the reminder work?

you get one a day, at the time you chose. you can change the time from the studio. with notifications off, the app still works.

where do the suggestions for empty days come from?

if you agree, an artificial intelligence (Claude, by Anthropic) reads the answers you gave at the start, once, and writes goals made for you. the suggestions stay on your iPhone. you can change your mind from the studio.

where are my goals and notes?

on your iPhone. there's no account and we don't send them to anyone. the details are in the privacy policy.

does it work offline?

yes. it only needs a connection to write the suggestions the first time.

how do I delete everything?

in the studio settings, "delete everything" removes your goals, paintings and answers. deleting the app from your phone also deletes everything you've written. if you've sent us a message and want us to delete it, write to us.

is it on Android?

for now 1thing is only for iPhone.

didn't find your answer? feedback@1thingapp.com
